blocks.note: Complete the affirmative and negative familiar-command paradigm while keeping the positive-form and subjunctive routes distinct.
Replace infinitives with complete affirmative vosotros commands, including pronominal forms and irregular lexical stems.
Attach one or two object pronouns to affirmative commands and preserve their order, spelling, and stress.
Turn affirmative commands into negative commands by moving pronouns before a present-subjunctive verb.
Form first-person plural imperatives and apply the special spelling and pronoun rules of nosotros commands.
Express relayed third-person instructions with que plus subjunctive, adding object pronouns where context requires them.
Rewrite passive-se procedural instructions as compact infinitive commands while preserving the complete instruction.
